metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code plugins that streamline the OpenCell developer workflow — from Jira ticket management and UI scaffolding to automated commits, pull requests, and code review. Jira and Confluence come from the official Atlassian plugin in Anthropic's claude-plugins-official marketplace; Figma, Playwright, Opencell, SonarQube and PostgreSQL ship here.

plugins.name: oc-fe-engineer
plugins.description: Expert React/TypeScript UI engineer sub-agent for building, refactoring, and architecting frontend components

plugins.name: oc-fe-reviewer
plugins.description: Frontend code reviewer sub-agent for validating React/TypeScript code against project standards

plugins.name: oc-fe-designer
plugins.description: Frontend designer sub-agent for translating Figma designs into implementation-ready React/MUI components with design tokens and styling

plugins.name: oc-fe-test-writer
plugins.description: Frontend test writer sub-agent and /oc-fe-write-tests command that write Vitest tests for changed React/TypeScript code (or specific files) following OpenCell Portal testing conventions

plugins.name: oc-fe-create-ui
plugins.description: Create UI page from JIRA ticket ID using the oc-fe-engineer sub-agent

plugins.name: oc-fe-fix-bug
plugins.description: Fix a bug from a JIRA ticket: update status, create fix branch, and start fixing

plugins.name: oc-fe-fix-pr
plugins.description: Fix the review remarks of a pull request: read its unresolved Bitbucket comments, fix them on the PR branch via oc-fe-engineer, then reply, resolve, and push

plugins.name: oc-fe-cypress-expert
plugins.description: Cypress testing expert sub-agent for end-to-end testing, test automation, and flaky test resolution

plugins.name: oc-fe-create-e2e-test
plugins.description: Create Playwright E2E tests from JIRA ticket requirements using the oc-fe-e2e-expert sub-agent

plugins.name: oc-fe-regression-test
plugins.description: Diff-driven Playwright regression tests for changed OpenCell Portal screens, written on the current branch after the Vitest step so they are part of the PR

plugins.name: oc-fe-calculate-ai-use
plugins.description: Estimate AI contribution and retention on the OpenCell Portal (/oc-fe-calculate-ai-use) from the frontend sub-agent manifests, first-pass snapshots, session transcript and file-history — per-category breakdown (components, i18n, unit tests, e2e, styles), Vitest/Playwright test counts, reviewer-rework provenance, planning-effort band, ai_Dev_Front / ai_test_front_dev Jira tagging, and the shared machine-readable JSON record for cross-team reporting; runs automatically at the end of /oc-pull-request on opencell-portal

plugins.name: oc-be-tools
plugins.description: Backend development toolkit for Opencell Core — agents for building entities, services, APIs, tests, and Postman collections, guideline-loading skills, an implementation orchestrator (/oc-be-implement), and a guideline-based code review command (/oc-be-review)

plugins.name: oc-ov-tools
plugins.description: Overlay development toolkit for Opencell overlay/vertical repositories (opencell-vertical-energy, overlay-project-template) — a thin DELTA layer over oc-be-tools, whose guidelines stay authoritative and load first. Covers apiv0 REST (/ve/, IBaseRs/BaseRs/BaseApi, plain-POJO DTOs), core-service extension via @Specializes, overlay Liquibase (db_resources/{current,rebuild}/overlay.xml and the LiquibaseFileTest-enforced pairing), ScriptInstance and Job authoring (getServiceInterface, the deploy mojo), maven-war-overlay and core-override rules, Postman and Jasper conventions, and the target-branch-suffixed git workflow. Ships nine guideline-loading skills, builder agents for entities/Liquibase, @Specializes services, apiv0 APIs and scripts/jobs, an overlay-aware PR reviewer, an implementation orchestrator (/oc-ov-implement) and a review command (/oc-ov-review) with nine overlay mechanical gates. REQUIRES oc-be-tools@opencell-tools.

plugins.name: oc-mc-tools
plugins.description: MACO development toolkit for opencell-maco-project (Spring Boot 2.3 / Java 11 / javax.* / Flyway / Spring Data / Spring Batch) — a STANDALONE toolkit, not a delta over oc-be-tools, because the Opencell Core backend rules are inverted here (javax vs Jakarta, Flyway vs Liquibase, @RestController vs BaseRs, Spring Data vs entity base classes, JUnit 4 + MockMvc vs Arquillian, no AGPL header, no Lombok). Ships ten guideline files (critical rules with a core-vs-MACO comparison table, module architecture and dependency direction, entities/sequences/projection DTOs, Spring Data repositories, services with the no-@Transactional convention, the /api/rest/v3 CRUD + FiltersDto/ResponseDto search template with @Secured Keycloak roles and Swagger 2, Spring Batch with thread-safe readers and StepExecution counters, Flyway migrations, code quality, testing), seven guideline-loading skills, builder agents for entities+migrations, repositories/services, batch jobs, REST APIs and JUnit 4 tests, a MACO-aware PR reviewer with an explicit scoring rubric, an implementation orchestrator (/oc-mc-implement) whose sub-agents record file manifests and first-pass snapshots, a two-axis review command (/oc-mc-review) folding guideline and JIRA acceptance-criteria conformance into one verdict and tagging the ticket ai_code_review_back, and a thin AI-usage alias (/oc-mc-calculate-ai-use) supplying the MACO repo profile to the shared cross-team analyzer. Tickets are raised in MACRD. /oc-mc-calculate-ai-use REQUIRES oc-be-tools@opencell-tools.

plugins.name: oc-ar-tools
plugins.description: Archi design toolkit for Opencell Core — agents and skills for US analysis and technical design

plugins.name: oc-ar-ai-tools
plugins.description: Archi design toolkit for Opencell Core — agents and skills for US analysis and technical design dedicated to claude AI developpement

plugins.name: oc-cache-jira
plugins.description: Fetch and cache JIRA ticket data locally for use by other OpenCell commands

plugins.name: oc-commit
plugins.description: Commit changes using JIRA ticket ID and summary from cache with automatic code review

plugins.name: oc-pull-request
plugins.description: Push changes and create a pull request for a JIRA ticket with automatic squash and PR creation, then records the ticket's AI usage via /oc-fe-calculate-ai-use on the squashed commit — opencell-portal only, idempotent, and non-fatal

plugins.name: oc-review-pr
plugins.description: Review a pull request linked to a JIRA ticket using the oc-fe-reviewer agent with a detailed report headed by the PR's Vitest test count, plus suggested fixes

plugins.name: oc-ai-report
plugins.description: Cross-ticket AI-usage report over a period — reads the AI-metrics JSON (backend/frontend/QA) from Jira, groups by area → date → user → ticket, with Architect & Dev-lead estimates, Tempo-logged time, sub-bug count/hours (cross-area sub-bugs annotated, not mixed in), Review-phase %, two time gains (with/without bugs), Jira status and a Final flag, AI-contrib-below-60% red; users ordered by area then name; five HTML tabs. Full-width HTML + CSV to ./docs/. Read-only; Jira via direct REST (mandatory JIRA_API_TOKEN, no MCP) + optional Tempo

plugins.name: oc-time-report
plugins.description: Estimation-vs-logged-hours report over a period (independent of the AI-usage JSON) — Tempo-worklog driven, one row per ticket with a PER-AREA column group (Backend/Frontend/QA): area main developer, Architect & Dev-lead estimates, logged/sub-bug hours, AI flag, two gains (with/without sub-bugs) and sub-bug count, plus an Arch/PR/management logged column and total. Date per ticket + month grouping, five HTML tabs, and a second finished-US per-developer summary. Date-stamped HTML + CSV to ./docs/. Jira via direct REST + Tempo per-user, both mandatory tokens; no MCP

plugins.name: oc-bug-clusters
plugins.description: Period-scoped bug clustering: classify the bugs created in a window onto a subject taxonomy, group subjects carrying at least 5 bugs, and optionally create one Jira Enabler per area with a Sub-task per cluster

plugins.name: oc-figma-mcp
plugins.description: Connect to Figma MCP server to extract design context, generate code from designs, and retrieve design tokens

plugins.name: oc-playwright-mcp
plugins.description: Connect to Playwright MCP server to automate browser interactions, take screenshots, and test web applications

plugins.name: oc-opencell-mcp
plugins.description: Connect to the Opencell billing system via MCP to manage invoices, quotes, customers, payments, subscriptions, dunning, and all billing operations

plugins.name: oc-sonar-mcp
plugins.description: Connect to SonarQube MCP server to access code quality metrics, issues, and analysis results

plugins.name: oc-postgres-mcp
plugins.description: Connect to PostgreSQL via MCP for database health analysis, index tuning, query optimization, and safe SQL execution

plugins.name: oc-fn-tools
plugins.description: Functional/product toolkit for Opencell — Jira INTRD issue authoring (oc-fn-func-design), Confluence docs-space authoring (oc-fn-documentation), Playwright-driven Opencell Portal navigation & screenshots (oc-fn-portal), the design-first phased delivery methodology (oc-fn-project-management), branded slide-deck authoring & rendering with the Opencell Marp theme (oc-fn-decks), branded one-pager / note / brief authoring & PDF rendering (oc-fn-briefs), and GUI/screen design against the Opencell Figma design system (oc-fn-gui-design). Bundles a headless Playwright MCP server (oc-fn-playwright).
